findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 55 mm is observed in the body of the pancreas. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. The tumor is in contact with the aorta, with an indistinct boundary, suggesting invasion. No other local invasion factors are identified. Lymph node metastasis is observed in one node at station 9. No other metastases are observed.
